mapper.sql: WITH SELECT bucket_date, tier_key, COUNT(*)::bigint AS player_count, MIN(sort_order)::int AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT t.bucket_date, ( CASE WHEN t.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 'L' WHEN t.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 'G' WHEN t.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 'P' WHEN t.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 'C' WHEN t.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 'F' ELSE 'Ch' END ) || CASE WHEN (t.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (t.rating_val % 10)::text ELSE '2' END AS tier_key, ( CASE WHEN t.rating_val >= 5000 THEN 60 WHEN t.rating_val >= 4000 THEN 50 WHEN t.rating_val >= 3500 THEN 40 WHEN t.rating_val >= 3000 THEN 30 WHEN t.rating_val >= 2000 THEN 20 ELSE 10 END + CASE WHEN (t.rating_val % 10) IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (t.rating_val % 10) ELSE 2 END ) AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT r.date_add::date AS bucket_date, MAX(u.rating_id) AS rating_val FROM rta_match_in_season r INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.rating_id >= 1000 GROUP BY r.date_add::date, u.wizard_id ) t ) x GROUP BY bucket_date, tier_key

win_agg AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, COUNT(*)::bigint AS match_count, SUM(CASE WHEN u.is_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::bigint AS win_count FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.ladder_score > 0 GROUP BY u.wizard_id )

wizard_last_match AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.replay_id AS last_rid FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.ladder_score > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, r.date_add DESC ), latest AS ( SELECT u.wizard_id, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, u.ladder_score AS score, u.rating_id AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM wizard_last_match tw INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON u.replay_id = tw.last_rid AND u.wizard_id = tw.wizard_id INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON r.rid = tw.last_rid )

top_wizards AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (u.wizard_id) u.wizard_id, u.replay_id AS last_rid, u.ladder_score AS max_score FROM public.rta_match_participant u INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON u.replay_id = r.rid WHERE u.ladder_score > 0 ORDER BY u.wizard_id, u.ladder_score DESC, u.replay_id DESC ), summoner_rank_detail AS ( SELECT tw.wizard_id, tw.max_score, u.wizard_name, u.country_code AS country, u.channel_uid, u.ladder_score AS score, u.rating_id AS rating_id, r.date_add AS last_match_at FROM top_wizards tw INNER JOIN public.rta_match_participant u ON u.replay_id = tw.last_rid AND u.wizard_id = tw.wizard_id INNER JOIN rta_match_in_season r ON r.rid = tw.last_rid )

COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(${alias}.image_url), ''), CASE WHEN ${alias}.kr_name IS NOT NULL AND ${alias}.monster_elemental IS NOT NULL THEN '/images/' || ${alias}.monster_elemental || '/' || replace(${alias}.kr_name, ' ', '_') || '_' || ${alias}.monster_elemental || '_Icon.png' ELSE NULL END )
